name: Ice Storm
description: A cylinder of radius 20 feet and height 40 feet. Each creature makes a Dexterity save, taking 2d8 bludgeoning and 4d6 cold on a failure, or half of each on a success. The cold does not increase when upcast; the bludgeoning gains 1d8 per slot level above 4th. The area is difficult terrain until the end of the caster's next turn, even if every save succeeds. Not concentration.

m.text: a pinch of dust and a few drops of water
